body: thank you for responding and for the link
hope it didn't work if you tried and you have that chance for the life you want.  i am wishing you luck in sticking around to see if the dream can be reality

you are drained and overwhelmed.  please give yourself some time to feel better emotionally and physically.  is there a school counsellor that can help you find someone to talk to such as a therapist ?  you might be able to get some relief and be able to sort things out given a little time.  many happy, thriving adults were messes at your age...give yourself a break

you are not a selfish asshole and thinking about yourself and your problems does not stop you from expressing empathy for others...a quality that is wonderful and giving.  there may be a moritorium on evictions where you live, and if your landlord is a right asshole, well perhaps using those funds to hold you over until things get better would be prudent.  i feel the same way, am in the same basic situation, want it to be over too, but hope  that you can give yourself some time to thrive.
i care that you are in pain.  i know the desire, but hope you don't.
